summary: An NDTV news broadcast discussing an emergency shutdown at the Kakrapar atomic power station in Gujarat due to a heavy water leak, featuring an interview with former Atomic Energy Commission Chairman M.R. Srinivasan.

spans.shows: An NDTV news studio with a male anchor standing in front of a large screen showing graphics about an emergency shutdown.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN OF NUCLEAR REACTOR

spans.shows: Anchor gesturing toward a screen displaying news about Kakrapar reactor shutdown.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN OF NUCLEAR REACTOR, GUJARAT KAKRAPAR, INDIA'S 220 MW NUCLEAR REACTOR AT KAKRAPAR, GUJARAT SHUTS DOWN

spans.shows: Anchor speaking in front of the studio screen detailing the reactor shutdown and water leakage.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN OF NUCLEAR REACTOR, SHUT DOWN AFTER HEAVY WATER LEAKAGE, EMERGENCY DECLARED

spans.shows: Anchor continuing news report about workers, radiation checks, and reactor cooling status.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN OF NUCLEAR REACTOR, NO RADIOACTIVE LEAK, HIGH TEMPERATURE HEAVY WATER LEAKS INSIDE THE SEALED REACTOR BUILDING, NUCLEAR REACTOR STILL COOLING DOWN

spans.shows: Anchor talking to M.R. Srinivasan, former chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission, via a video wall link.
spans.place_people: NDTV studio, M.R. Srinivasan (Former Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission of India)
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, EMERGENCY IN GUJARAT N-PLANT, 'No radioactive leak', Reactor in Kakrapar plant shut down after major water leak, MR Sreenivasan, Former Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission of India

spans.shows: Split screen of anchor and M.R. Srinivasan discussing safety systems and shutdown procedures.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, THE BUCK STOPS HERE, EMERGENCY IN GUJARAT N-PLANT, MR Sreenivasan, Former Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission of India

spans.shows: Discussion continues between anchor and M.R. Srinivasan on worker safety and radiation levels.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN OF NUCLEAR REACTOR, EMERGENCY IN GUJARAT N-PLANT, MR Sreenivasan, Former Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission of India

spans.shows: Anchor and M.R. Srinivasan wrapping up the interview regarding the Kakrapar reactor status and safety measures.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN OF NUCLEAR REACTOR, EMERGENCY IN GUJARAT N-PLANT, MR Sreenivasan, Former Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission of India
